name: Fortive
description: After spinning off its Precision Technologies segment as Ralliant on 2025-06-28, Fortive is two businesses: Intelligent Operating Solutions, which sells Fluke test instruments, Industrial Scientific gas monitors and a growing set of software (ServiceChannel, Gordian, Accruent, Intelex) for maintenance, facilities and workplace safety, and Advanced Healthcare Solutions, which sells instrument sterilisation (ASP), instrument tracking (Censis), radiation monitoring (Landauer), biomedical test tools and clinical software (Provation) to hospitals. Gross margin is 63.5 percent: a mix of one-time instrument sales, consumables and recurring software and service subscriptions.

employees.note: 10-K says 'over 10,000 people'; exact count not given.

businessLines.name: Intelligent Operating Solutions (IOS)
businessLines.how: Sells professional test and measurement instruments (Fluke) and gas monitors (Industrial Scientific) through distributors and direct (one-time hardware plus service), and subscription software for facility and asset management, contractor networks and EHS compliance (ServiceChannel, Gordian, Accruent, Intelex), to tens of thousands of customers.

businessLines.name: Advanced Healthcare Solutions (AHS)
businessLines.how: Sells instrument-sterilisation equipment with recurring consumables (ASP), instrument-tracking and workflow software (Censis), biomedical test tools, radiation-dosimetry monitoring services (Landauer) and clinical productivity software (Provation) to hospitals and healthcare providers: equipment, consumables and software subscriptions.

brands.name: Ralliant Corporation (former Precision Technologies segment, spun off)
brands.note: Separation completed 2025-06-28 by pro-rata distribution to Fortive shareholders; reported as discontinued operations, so excluded from all figures above.
